description: This file defines the TreeRule class, which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages rule evaluation based on a hierarchical or tree structure, allowing recursive evaluation of subordinate rules within AWS endpoint resolution logic.

classes.name: TreeRule
classes.description: A class representing a tree-structured rule used for complex condition evaluations in endpoint resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TreeRule instance with a definition array and creates subordinate rules.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the array of subordinate rules.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Recursively evaluates the rule tree based on input parameters and a standard library, returning the evaluation result or false.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates an array of rule objects from a provided array of rule definitions.
